question: Where can I find the closest zoo toward the west of Mays Chapel Medical Care Center, Lutherville, MD?
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'zoo' AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mays Chapel Medical Care Center%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry )) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5 ORDER BY ST_Distance( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mays Chapel Medical Care Center%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, geometry::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;

answers.poi_name: Heavenly Heart Farm & Mini Petting Zoo
answers.description: Traveling petting zoo, open on location for special events or by appointment. Contact via email or phone for details.
